source_columns.names: publisher names from the source contract
source_columns.representation: all values retain decoded source lexemes as Parquet UTF8
source_columns.ordering: physical leaf order is canonical Parquet schema order and must be resolved by name

added_columns.name: lt_source_row_ordinal
added_columns.meaning: one-based row ordinal in the selected immutable COPY relation

added_columns.name: lt_source_raw_byte_offset
added_columns.meaning: zero-based uncompressed byte offset of the source row

added_columns.name: lt_source_raw_byte_length
added_columns.meaning: source row byte length including the terminating line feed

added_columns.name: lt_disbursement_amount_source_scale
added_columns.meaning: fractional digit count in the source amount lexeme

added_columns.name: lt_bundled_refund_minor_units
added_columns.meaning: losslessly parsed signed bundled-refund USD cents

added_columns.name: lt_bundled_refund_source_scale
added_columns.meaning: fractional digit count in the source bundled-refund lexeme

added_columns.name: lt_disbursement_date
added_columns.meaning: calendar date derived from the source local disbursement timestamp

added_columns.name: lt_disbursement_at_local
added_columns.meaning: source disbursement timestamp without invented timezone

added_columns.name: lt_communication_date
added_columns.meaning: calendar date derived from the source local communication timestamp

added_columns.name: lt_communication_at_local
added_columns.meaning: source communication timestamp without invented timezone

added_columns.name: lt_publisher_loaded_at_local
added_columns.meaning: publisher load timestamp without invented timezone

added_columns.name: lt_memoed_subtotal
added_columns.meaning: true exactly when memo_cd equals X; no counting decision

identity.per_row_hashes: derived on demand; not stored as high-cardinality physical columns
